tools.name: book_discovery_call
tools.description: Opens the Node8 booking calendar so the visitor can schedule a free 20-minute discovery call with the team. Use this when the visitor is ready to speak with someone directly.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Returns structured information about Node8 — what the company does, its three-step service model, ideal customer profile, and technology partners. Use this first to understand if Node8 is a fit.

tools.name: navigate_to_solution
tools.description: Navigates to the most relevant Node8 AI solution page for the visitor's industry or use case. Use this when a visitor wants to find which Node8 solution fits their needs.

industry.description: The visitor's industry or primary business focus.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Submits a written contact inquiry to the Node8 team. Use this when someone wants to describe their problem and request a proposal or callback — without scheduling a call right now.

name.description: Full name of the person reaching out

message.description: What the team does manually today and what they want to automate or improve.
